Third BLOCK, correct: deleting only the branch would orphan _ci_environment() (its sole caller), leaving dead code whose docstring argues FOR the behaviour being removed.

Enumerated the full edit set in the plan rather than discovering it mid-change: the helper and its branch in scripts/mutation_sandbox.py; five tests in tests/scripts/test_mutation_sandbox.py (three removed or inverted, two that stay meaningful); the stale CI-fallback prose in docs/local-dev-env.md; and _mutation.yml, which must declare the waiver explicitly and have its 'fails CLOSED' comment corrected. file_impact updated to those four paths.
